g.text: Group by information type, across consultations.
Soft curves: variation across hypothetical consultations.
Dot and short line: median and middle 50%, not uncertainty.
120 simulated cases per type, reused from the selective-loss concept.
These are not the 320 cases in the adjacent map or the saved pilot.
Category differences are constructed; they do not establish bias.
